category: Tier Engine & Config (single source of truth)

features.name: Tier configuration store
features.detail: The canonical config: {tiers, special_rules, settings}. 6 tiers, 31 sub-labels, ~104 sender rules, ~81 subject keywords. settings = {classify_interval_minutes:15, triage_after_days:30, triage_time:'01:00', apps_script_id}. Everything else (labels, filters, Apps Script) is derived from this file.

features.name: Stats aggregator
features.detail: Rolls up config.json into total_labels / total_senders / total_subjects / total_rules + per-tier counts and color metadata for the dashboard cards.

features.name: Backed-up config save
features.detail: Writes config.json.bak (shutil.copy2) before every overwrite, then dumps JSON with ensure_ascii=False. Read/write exposed via GET/POST /api/config and /api/designer/save.

features.name: Rules-engine classifier (Apps Script side)
features.detail: Lowercases From + Subject, runs classifyRokid_() special rule first, then iterates TIER_RULES matching sender substrings then subject keywords; returns the full 'Tier/Sub-label' name or null. labelCache_ memoizes GmailApp label lookups.

features.name: classifyNewEmails — 15-min sweep
features.detail: GmailApp.search('in:inbox is:unread', 0, 50). For each thread, classify the latest message, add the sub-label + parent tier label, then moveToArchive(). 5-minute hard runtime guard. Logs classified/unclassified counts.

features.name: triageStaleInbox — nightly
features.detail: Searches 'in:inbox before:<today-30d>'; any thread without a '[1-6] -' label gets the _Triage label and is archived. Runs daily at 1 AM.

features.name: classifyAllInbox — full backfill
features.detail: Like classifyNewEmails but scans up to 100 inbox threads and skips any already carrying a tier label (regex /^[1-6] -/).

features.name: setupTriggers / dryRun / listTierLabels
features.detail: setupTriggers() clears existing triggers and registers the 15-min + daily jobs. dryRun() previews classification on 30 threads with a hit-rate. listTierLabels() prints the tier label set.

features.name: Apps Script generator
features.detail: Serializes config.tiers into the TIER_RULES JS object, then appends the static engine (classifyMessage_, getLabel_, classify*, triage*, setupTriggers). Written to EasyFlow_AppsScript.js via POST /api/generate-script.

features.name: Page routes
features.detail: Jinja2 templates in Tools/templates/ (base, dashboard, configure, configure_tier, designer, deploy, cleanup, migrate, settings, welcome, manual). welcome doubles as the first-run setup wizard.

features.name: Tier/label CRUD API
features.detail: POST /api/tier (add tier), POST/PUT/DELETE /api/tier/<tier>/label/<label> with 400/404/409 status codes. /api/designer/save replaces the whole tier tree.

features.name: Manual screenshot sync
features.detail: On startup copies Manual/*.png|jpg|gif into static/manual/ with URL-safe names, only when newer — serves the in-app setup manual.

features.name: Colored label-tree creation
features.detail: Defines the full LABELS list with one of 9 Gmail palette colors (red/orange/yellow/blue/purple/gray/black/teal/green). Skips existing labels; nests via '/'. Idempotent.

features.name: Config-to-filter compiler
features.detail: Turns each tier rule into Gmail filter defs: senders batched 5-per OR query (from:a OR from:b...), subjects batched 5-per (subject:(kw)...). Each filter adds the label and removes INBOX. CLI: --dry-run / --list / --clear.

features.name: Filter create/list/clear API
features.detail: Imports create_filters at runtime. /create needs the separate gmail.settings.basic token (token_gmail_filters.json). /clear removes only filters targeting EasyFlow tier labels.

features.name: Label cleanup (retire / delete)
features.detail: Either renames a label to _Retired/<name> (reversible) or permanently deletes it. Counts removed/errors. Also /api/gmail/label-visibility + /api/gmail/categories-toggle for system-label visibility.

features.name: Legacy-label migration
features.detail: scan finds _Retired/ Z_Legacy T0-T5 labels with message/thread counts; execute batch-moves messages (batchModify, 1000/batch, up to 5000 per source) into the chosen tier + parent label, optional after:<cutoff>.

features.name: Manifest V3 + permissions
features.detail: v1.2.1. permissions: identity, storage, alarms, sidePanel, activeTab, tabs, downloads, notifications. oauth2 scopes: gmail.labels, gmail.modify, gmail.settings.basic, contacts. host_permissions for googleapis, generativelanguage, people, openai, anthropic, localhost. content script on mail.google.com.

features.name: Service worker (ES module)
features.detail: type:module MV3 worker. Owns OAuth, gmailFetch, AI providers, classification, alarms, and the diagnostic logger. Cannot import classic scripts, so it replicates the logger inline (shared _LOG_KEY).

features.name: chrome.alarms classification job
features.detail: alarms-driven periodic classification, immune to service-worker termination. v1.2.1 distinguishes network vs auth errors in the alarm handler (commit 505dd6e).

features.name: chrome.storage.local state
features.detail: Holds config, API keys, debug log (easyflow.debuglog, 1000-entry cap), cached web-flow token, stuck-label state. No external server needed for the in-browser path.

features.name: Dual-path auth (Chrome + Edge)
features.detail: Probes chrome.identity.getAuthToken (Chrome app client); on 'not supported'/'Microsoft Edge' falls back to chrome.identity.launchWebAuthFlow with a separate Web OAuth client, caching the result in storage. Remembers which path worked (_authMethod).

features.name: Resilient gmailFetch
features.detail: Wraps fetch with Bearer auth, AbortController hard timeout (10s GET / 60s destructive), 401 token-refresh-and-retry-once, 429 exponential backoff (2/4/8s), and network-error backoff (2/4s, 2 retries). Treats Gmail cascade-404 as benign.

features.name: Token management
features.detail: removeCachedToken() clears Chrome's cache or the stored web-flow token; revokeToken() hits Google's revoke endpoint. Per-verb timeout picker _pickTimeout().

features.name: Flask-side OAuth flow
features.detail: google-auth-oauthlib Flow with PKCE (code_verifier in session), OAUTHLIB_INSECURE_TRANSPORT for localhost. Tokens: token_gmail.json (labels+modify), token_gmail_filters.json (settings.basic), token_apps_script.json (script.projects).

features.name: AI triage batch
features.detail: Pre-flight NO_TIERS guard; builds a valid-target set from the tier tree; queries inbox/Triage messages; for each, sends From/Subject/snippet to the chosen LLM and parses a {label, confidence} JSON. Rejects any label not in the tree. Up to 200 msgs.

features.name: Provider router
features.detail: Single-provider model. Conversational chat → callProvider; classification → callLLMForClassification. Both pick from the four adapters by the user's configured provider.

features.name: Provider adapters
features.detail: Gemini (gemini-2.0-flash generateContent), Ollama (/api/chat, local), OpenAI-compatible (/chat/completions, custom baseUrl), Anthropic (/messages). Keys from chrome.storage.local; only metadata + snippet leave the browser.

features.name: Triage prompt builders
features.detail: System prompt enumerates valid tiers + sub-labels and instructs label='' confidence=0 when unsure. User prompt carries From/Subject/Snippet. Response parser tolerates non-JSON and logs the raw text for debugging.

features.name: Chat-style side panel
features.detail: sendMessage() promisifies chrome.runtime.sendMessage. addChatBubble/HTML render the conversation. init() wires login/app states, theme, welcome guide. Theme via applyThemeSP()/loadTheme().

features.name: Stuck-label retry machine
features.detail: _stuckState tracks failed label IDs + attempt number. Attempt 1 retries via the worker; if still stuck, escalates to attempt 2; final fallback shows explicit manual-cleanup guidance (no infinite retry).

features.name: i18n system
features.detail: Works in both worker and page contexts. 10 locales under _locales/ (en, zh_CN, fr, de, ja, ko, pt_BR, es, hi, ru). command-i18n covers commands, guide-i18n covers onboarding, i18n covers UI strings.

features.name: Content script (Gmail enhance)
features.detail: Injected at document_idle on https://mail.google.com/*. Enhances the Gmail surface; CSS loaded alongside.

features.name: Build & version tooling
features.detail: Versioned build scripts package the Chrome + Edge zips and bump version strings across manifest, locales, and tests. Current build v1.2.1 (EasyFlow_Chrome.zip / EasyFlow_Edge.zip).

features.name: i18n maintenance scripts
features.detail: ~30 Python helpers that add/verify translation keys across the 10 locale files — the i18n upkeep toolchain.

features.name: Extension test suites
features.detail: dry_run.js validates label ops without live API calls; regression + v12 feature tests cover extension logic. Run manually (no CI wiring yet).

features.name: Python smoke test
features.detail: Project smoke test scaffold under tests/. Not yet wired into an automated runner.

features.name: Brain reporting hooks
features.detail: Helper scripts to report sessions/state to QI Brain. Hive reporting block is present in .claude/CLAUDE.md; full qi.* integration still pending.
